versions.changelog:
- Updated version to 1.0.1 in SKILL.md.
- No functional or workflow changes; documentation text only.

Initial release of room-makeover-video skill.

- Generate vertical home makeover videos: rental glow-ups, balcony café nooks, themed kid’s rooms, strong before/after shots.
- Expands brief prompts into full, detailed English video production prompts (camera, light, payoff, vertical).
- Supports WeryAI API for generation via Node.js script; requires API key and Node.js 18+.
- Always confirms expanded full prompt and key params with user before generation.
- Documents security, local file consent, model restrictions, and workflow in detail.
